integrity: All results are stated with proof, finite test boundaries and explicit limits; no independent audit or external certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The statements concern exact contiguous nonempty distinct square factors of five-run positive binary words. The 2014 SOFSEM proceedings article could not be inspected in full; only the author talk was read, leaving a residual possible-coverage risk. Finite enumerations corroborate and do not prove the infinite formulas. The asymptotic law is for uniform positive five-part compositions.
title: Five-run binary square factors: synchronized lengths, sharp extrema and rare resonance
